messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: NicheMapR v3.3.1 released
parts:
Hi everyone,

I just put out a new release of NicheMapR - the changes are all explained in the notes for the release. Of the major additions, the leaf temperature aspects are part of a paper that should come out in the next few months, the torpor model will also be part of a paper that's a fair way through the review process and the the snakey DEB things are part of a project I'm working on at the moment. 

I updated the help on the NicheMapR website to include a couple of new vignettes too, one on leaf temperature calculations and another on the Soil Plant Atmosphere Continuum (SPAC) model used in the microclimate model to compute soil moisture as a function of a transpiring plant.

All the best,
Mike
